text: The only open issue (search, dependency drift) was on the boulder's dark underside; no marker on the boulder or HUD said where it was. Took ~5 real minutes of looking around/walking around the boulder to find it. The red 'ui' label appeared on the boulder right after a release, but no label for search.

On terrace 0.4 with billing and ui open, I could not find either module on the boulder after several minutes: open modules have no marker; colours repeat (purple was 'router' at 0.2, 'cache' at 0.4; dark brown/black faces are hard to tell apart), and the prompt is the only way to identify a face. Gave up and pushed on.

After sitting (Q) the HUD line 'Next release 1.0 (the summit): 34 m uphill (behind y...' is cut off at the right edge of the 640px window. Also: while sitting the whole HUD is hidden, so you cannot watch stamina refill or issues rot while resting; on standing billing had gone DOWN (outage) with no alert visible while seated.

HUD text collision: with 5+ open issues the issue list runs into the centre prompt ('On the slope it rolls back...' overprinted on the uploads row), and at 8 issues a centre message ('router: expiring certificate') is drawn over the router row. Unreadable.

Death spiral at 0.6: billing went down while I was pushing (it sat at the boulder's contact point, unreachable), then search, auth went down; router rotting -101%/min; weight maxed: 'too heavy to push uphill' and the boulder rolled back from 5 m below the summit to the 0.6 terrace. With 8-9 issues the module prompt under the crosshair is overprinted by the issue list so I could not tell which module I was aiming at (patched ui by accident when aiming at a downed one).
Earlier rollback screen: at 5 m below 1.0, weight hit max and the boulder slid back 23 m to the terrace; feedback text 'It's rolling back down... it stops at the one below' overlapped the issue list.
